roles.final: D compartment sealed; no final evaluation release

transport.timeout_scope: Read inactivity, not hard total request deadline

old_cache: Immutable old STOP, journals and pending artifacts retained. Copy verified opaque blocks into new envelopes under trusted custody. Verify old marker source, range, SHA, response result and sequential intent identity. Carry consumed request counts forward. One previously verified pending block may be committed only after complete re-verification; never call old pending complete retroactively. Missing/corrupt/conflicting evidence fails closed, no fresh-budget reset.
checkpoint: Reuse unchanged synthetic-verified atomic_checkpoint function code via narrowly scoped globals adapter. Protected same-volume staging, full SHA256 envelope, closed/flushed handles, MoveFileEx initial publication, ReplaceFile only explicit previous hash, <=3 cumulative local attempts. No directory rename, no ACL broadening, no unlimited permission retries.
reuse: Eight original receipts, ciphertexts, keys and private provenance hashes verified against original issuer without decryption; unchanged extraction artifacts

science.offset: all three families same train-only stimulus/time/order log-rate offset, ridge=0.1, all seeds mean log-rate

preflight: No real source access before code seal, original eight hash verification, scoped native checkpoint canary, same-volume/reparse/DACL and native runtime/access-denial proof. No new 200-attempt synthetic campaign.
stop: Any failed environmental or custody prerequisite
Incomplete cohort is engineering blocker, not DATA_INSUFFICIENT
Complete cohort below 8 eligible in either group is DATA_INSUFFICIENT
Any later mandatory scientific gate failure
conditional: Only new M2 PASS permits frozen M3-M5 and required development nulls. No final unlock, dataset search or protocol redesign. New critical engineering failure requires separate authorization.
